input_gap.en: The selected H200/model/request failure or its per-rank worker/native traces. The source-only component and collector checks do not supply those incident traces.
input_gap.zh-CN: 所选H200／模型／请求故障的复现环境，或各rank的worker／原生轨迹；源码组件与采集器检查不能替代原始故障轨迹。

source_review_result.en: The2017 reporter says the queue still drains slowly; the2019 report says commit stops resolving and supplies pseudocode only. The2026 maintainer comparison did not reproduce the behavior. These reports must not be combined into one confirmed permanent hang.
source_review_result.zh-CN: 2017年作者澄清队列仍缓慢出队；2019年跟帖称commit不再完成，但只给伪代码；2026年维护者对照未复现。不能把它们合并为一个已确认的永久挂起。

input_gap.en: A reproducing script with SQL/schema, producer scheduling, exact Node/mysql2 versions and server setup; the2019 follow-up names MySQL5.7.28 but omits the complete program.
input_gap.zh-CN: 需要包含SQL／schema、生产者调度、精确Node／mysql2版本及服务端配置的复现脚本；2019年跟帖只提到MySQL5.7.28，未提供完整程序。

source_review_result.en: Selected build8667481512311181857 uses Windows386, tools@ba933928 and go@e9466ba2. Its gopls log has six hanging-command reports and two aggregated goroutine profiles. The pinned runCmdContext starts a one-minute debug timer before cancellation handling; WaitDelay is already30s. The profiles include Process.Wait/WaitForSingleObject, but omit goroutine-to-PID/creation identity. This is not proof of a post-kill pipe hang or a single cause for the umbrella issue.
source_review_result.zh-CN: 选定build8667481512311181857为Windows386、tools@ba933928及go@e9466ba2；gopls日志有六次hanging-command报告及两份聚合goroutine profile。固定源码的一分钟debug timer在取消处理之前启动，WaitDelay已设30秒。profile含Process.Wait／WaitForSingleObject，却没有goroutine到PID／创建身份关联，不能据此确认kill后的管道挂起或整个聚合issue的单一根因。

input_gap.en: A matching Windows failure with process/handle and goroutine identity, or a complete local reproducer. The Linux host cannot execute this selected Windows CI failure unchanged.
input_gap.zh-CN: 需要匹配Windows故障的进程／句柄与goroutine身份数据，或完整本地复现；当前Linux主机不能原样执行所选Windows CI故障。

input_gap.en: Matching binaries/build flags, application sources and load, completed RPC counts and Java JIT maps. Uploaded CPU profiles alone do not establish a repair or request ancestry.
input_gap.zh-CN: 匹配的二进制／构建选项、应用源码与负载、实际完成RPC数及Java JIT map；现有CPU轨迹不能独立验证修复或恢复请求祖先。
